title: Asomiya Proyog Ratnamala Vyakaran: Comparative Grammatical Treatise
author: Jitendra Nath Bhattacharya (Vyakaran Shastri)
genre: Grammatical Treatise, Historical Morphology & Assamese-Tai Comparative Syntax
description: Authoritative comparative grammatical treatise published in Guwahati by Sanskrit scholar and grammarian Jitendra Nath Bhattacharya. It examines the morphological rules of Purushottama Vidyavagisha's Prayoga Ratnamala Vyakaran, documenting indigenous syntax, sandhi euphonic combinations, case markers, and cross-linguistic influences from Tai-Ahom and Tibeto-Burman speech communities.
